title: 第8章  笑我是冤大头？其实我是借你命一用
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
李长生如今的修为，已经达到了炼气九层巅峰。
距离筑基仅剩一步之遥。
但资质太差了。
除非获得系统奖励。
否则的话，想要迈出这一步实在太难了。
李长生很急。
但也没办法。
如今安置区也出现问题了。
频繁有修士失踪。
这是青云宗脚下，仙门脚下啊，为什么会发生这种事？
李长生想了很久，只想到了两种可能。
一种，是仙门无情，根本不管他们的死活。
可是……
即便如此。
仙门的威慑还在。
外面的人一般不会冒着触怒仙门的风险，到安置区行凶的。
那就只有第二种可能了。
青云宗内部已腐朽了。
默许这种事情发生。
甚至有可能是青云宗的人干的。

如果这样的话，就解释得通了。
只是这个想法很危险，也很可怕。
原本李长生不愿意往这方面想的，但是现在失踪人越来越多，他又不得不往这方面想。
“夫君。”
“在想什么呢？”
江翠萍抱着李以宁，走出来，声音温柔问。
只见李长生坐在院子里藤椅中。
白发苍苍。
暮气沉沉。
外表看起来依旧是那个行将就木的老头。
但气质却有了不一样，具体哪里不一样，又说不上来。
李长生满是老人斑的双腿，时不时蹬一下地面，藤椅摇啊摇，颇有诗情画意的。
这时抬起头。
看了江翠萍一眼。
江翠萍脸色红润，皮肤白皙，大白腿很润，颇有一种被富家包养的少奶奶的感觉。
只是肚子鼓鼓的，有些显眼。
依旧很好看。
得到滋润之后，仿佛褪尽铅华，浑身散发着女人的魅力。
只是很可惜，江翠萍的修炼资质比我还差。
这已经不是差了。

而是完全不能修炼。
这让李长生颇为遗憾。
李长生站起来，从旁边搬了一张椅子，放在自己旁边。
“没想什么。”
“坐吧！”
“咱们一起看看夕阳。”
江翠萍坐在凳子上。
然后将闺女放在地上。
李以宁很活泼，刚落地，就走到李长生面前，奶声奶气叫了一声：
“爹爹，抱抱。”
李长生更是心花怒放。
转眼就差不多一年了。
宁宁不但会走路了。
还会简单地说话了。
眨眼间。
我的小棉袄。
就长大了啊！
“嗯，爹爹，抱抱。”
李长生张开双手，将宁宁抱起来。
哈哈……

李长生笑得更欢了。
宁宁跟别的孩子不一样，从小就很乖巧懂事，也不夜哭。
虽然才一岁，但却好像懂很多东西一样，一点都不难带。
李长生抱了一会之后。
宁宁就自己下去玩了。
留给李长生和江翠萍二人世界。
江翠萍想了想开口：“夫君，虽然你不说，但是我知道你有心事。最近安置区的失踪人口，越来越多，越来越频繁了，你担心咱们的安全对不对？”
李长生点点头。
他没想到江翠萍那么敏感。
竟然猜得七七八八了。
江翠萍摸了摸鼓起来的肚子道：“如果实在不行的话，咱们就离开这里吧？”
这的确是一种好方法。
只是我们真的能成功离开吗？
如今安置区频繁出事，如果我的猜测是真的话，腐朽的青云宗可不会让他们离开。
李长生伸出手，摸了摸江翠萍的肚子，不动声色地开口：
“我知道了。”
“放心吧！”
“我会保护好你们的。”
“嗯，我相信你。”江翠萍看着李长生的侧脸，轻轻地点头。
其实她知道李长生在藏拙，一整年了，容颜都没变过，彷月都没有在其身上留下任何痕迹。

这根本不是夫君的真实面容。
夫君的真实面容可能更年轻。
夕阳西下。
江翠萍依靠在李长生的胸膛。
李长生抚摸着江翠萍微微鼓起来的肚子。
这一幕成为了唯美的画卷。
当天夜里零点。
正躺在床上的李长生，忽然睁开眼睛，看了一眼江翠萍。
江翠萍睡得很沉，呼吸平稳，就是被子有点掉。
他帮其将被子扯上来。
防止婆娘着凉。
然后静悄悄往外面走去。
翠萍说得对。
安置区频繁有人失踪，一直苟在这里，也不是办法。
他想去看看能不能离开。
李长生往自己身上拍了一张三阶的隐身符，又拍了一张三阶的隐匿符。
虽然他的技能也能隐匿，但是使用灵符的话，有双重保险。
三阶灵符是他最近才学会画的。
原则上筑基巅峰之下无法看破。
李长生跟黑暗融为一体，就像一个幽灵，穿过了安置区街道，来到山口的位置，爬上一棵古树，举目远眺。

其实他来过这个位置很多次了.
当初去黑市也是从这里出去的。
但是后面就好几个月没有出去过了。
其实这里也没有什么不一样的。
看来我多心了。
想离开安置区还是可以的。
李长生观察了一会，顿时得到这个答案。
正当他准备跑路的时候。
远处突然出现了两个身影。
李长生看到这一幕，瞳孔猛然一缩。
虽然另一位裹着迷雾看不清，但是其中一位却很熟悉。
竟然是他？
实在太意外了。
谢剑是当初遣散他下山的外门长老。
目之所及之处。
此刻，谢剑鬼鬼祟祟的，围着山口不断洒下某种东西。
虽然李长生看不太懂，但是看久了，还是看出了一点东西。
谢剑长老洒下的应该是某种阵法材料。
所以……
谢剑在布阵？

在安置区出口布什么阵啊？
李长生喃喃一声，有一种不祥的预感。
他没敢走近看。
因为谢剑长老是筑基期的修为，靠得太近的话，容易被发现。
看来自己想象的没错。
无法离开了。
麻烦了啊！
等谢剑离开了之后，李长生才悄悄地离开。
他没有好奇地去查看。
因为好奇往往是作死的一种方式。
这一点无数穿越前辈已经验证过了。
李长生是不会让自己置身于危险中的。
李长生回到家之后，没打扰江翠萍，盘膝在客厅中修炼。
虽然他资质差，基本修炼没有用。
但能增长一点。
就增长一点吧！
昨晚看到了谢剑的出现。
证明了自己的想法。
青云宗已腐朽。
或者说是部分人已经腐朽。

想要活着的话。
那就得拼命。
第二天一早，李长生吃过早餐之后，想了想，便去隔壁杜老头家走去。
这是他被优化后第一次串门。
刚进门。
杜老头就笑吟吟地抱着娇妻走出来了。
杜老头的娇妻也很润。
只是跟江翠萍没得比的。
毕竟江翠萍旺夫。
“李老头。近一年都没见过你。我还以为你死了呢？现在怎么有空来串门了？”杜老头笑着问，声音令人有点不舒服。
哈哈……
“我养了个女娃，再加上身体不好，就不出门了。”
说着，李长生咳嗽两声，腰更弯了，甚至有点驼背。
随后接着开口：
“我娃的灵鹿奶喝光了。能不能帮我买两罐回来？”
“你自己怎么不去买？”
“我的腿有点不方便。而且也不让你白帮忙。我给你十块灵石跑腿费。”
杜老头闻言，目光瞬间就亮了。
十块灵石啊！
对于他来说已经很多了。

自从来到了安置区之后。
他几乎失去了所有赚灵石的渠道。
“早说嘛！”
“没问题。”
“包在我身上。”
“不就是两罐灵鹿奶吗？我去去就回。”
杜老头态度一百八十度转变。
一点都不客气。
一把抓过李长生递过来的灵石，塞进怀里。
那满是褶子的老脸笑得像朵枯萎的菊花。
十块灵石啊。
也就是跑跑腿的功夫。
李长生果然是个冤大头。
为了个赔钱的丫头片子。
居然出手这么阔绰。
李长生点点头：“好，快去快回啊！我家的娃还等着喝奶呢！”
“你在家等着，日落之前肯定回来。”
杜老头拍着胸脯保证。
随后跟娇妻交代了两句，便兴冲冲地出门了。
看着杜老头离开了，李长生脸上的憨厚，瞬间收敛，变成冰冷。

虽然说他的道德底线很低。
但是心头总会有一丝愧疚。
“对不住了。”
李长生心里默念了一句。
他不是圣母。
昨晚看到了谢剑布阵，就有一种不好的预感。
自己是不可能去赌的。
所以他需要一个投石问路的人。
贪财的杜老头就是最好的人选。
这很残酷。
但这就是修仙界。
死道友不死贫道。
李长生站在门口伫立了良久，直到一阵冷风吹过，卷起地上的枯叶，才转身，返回自己的家。
回到院子。
李长生没有表现出异常。
依旧像往常一样。
逗弄女儿。
陪妻子说话。
甚至还饶有兴致的，给未出世的老二，想了好几个名字。
只是神识却始终留意着安置区的入口方向。

他在等杜老头归来。
直到夜幕降临，杜老头都没有回来。
江翠萍哄睡了女儿，看着还在院子里独坐的李长生，轻声问道：
“夫君，在看什么？”
李长生回答：“我在看隔壁的杜老头回来了没有。”
江翠萍：“还没有回来吗？”
李长生：“没有。”
江翠萍：“都大半夜了，你说会不会出什么事了？”
李长生回过神，挂起温和的笑容，伸出手，将妻子有些冰凉的手握在掌心。
“能出什么事？”
“杜老头是个老滑头了，精明着呢。”
“估计是拿了钱贪杯了。”
“真的吗？”江翠萍有些迟疑问。
content_en:
Li Changsheng's current cultivation level has reached the peak of the ninth level of Qi refining.
There is only one step left to build the foundation.
But the qualifications are too poor.
Unless you get system rewards.
Otherwise, it would be too difficult to take this step.
Li Changsheng was very anxious.
But there is nothing we can do.
Now there are also problems in the resettlement area.
Frequent monks disappeared.
This is the foot of the Qingyun Sect, the foot of the Immortal Sect. Why does this happen?
Li Changsheng thought for a long time and could only think of two possibilities.
One is that the immortal sect is ruthless and doesn't care about their life or death at all.
But...
Even so.
The intimidation of the Immortal Sect is still there.
People outside generally would not risk offending the Immortal Sect by going to the resettlement area to commit crimes.
Then there is only the second possibility.
The Qingyun Sect is rotten internally.
Allow this to happen.
It might even be someone from the Qingyun Sect who did it.
If so, it makes sense.
It's just that this idea is dangerous and scary.
Li Changsheng originally didn't want to think about this, but now that more and more people are missing, he has to think about it.
"Husband."
"What are you thinking about?"
Jiang Cuiping hugged Li Yining and walked out, asking in a gentle voice.
Li Changsheng was seen sitting on a wicker chair in the yard.
White hair.
Twilight is heavy.
On the outside, he still looks like the dying old man.
But the temperament is different, and I can't say exactly what is different.
Li Changsheng's legs covered with age spots would kick on the ground from time to time, rocking the wicker chair, which was quite poetic.
Then he raised his head.
He glanced at Jiang Cuiping.
Jiang Cuiping has a rosy face, fair skin, and moist white legs. She looks like a young lady being kept by a rich family.
It's just that the bulging belly is a bit conspicuous.
Still looks great.
After being moisturized, the beauty seems to have faded away, and the whole body exudes the charm of a woman.
It's just a pity that Jiang Cuiping's cultivation qualifications are worse than mine.
This is no longer bad.
But it is impossible to practice at all.
This made Li Changsheng quite regretful.
Li Changsheng stood up, moved a chair from the side and placed it next to him.
"I didn't think anything of it."
"Sit down!"
"Let's watch the sunset together."
Jiang Cuiping sat on the stool.
Then put the girl on the ground.
Li Yining was very lively. As soon as he landed, he walked up to Li Changsheng and screamed:
"Daddy, give me a hug."
Li Changsheng was even more elated.
Almost a year has passed in the blink of an eye.
Ning Ning can not only walk.
He can also speak simply.
In the blink of an eye.
My little cotton-padded jacket.
He has grown up!
"Yeah, daddy, give me a hug."
Li Changsheng opened his hands and picked up Ning Ning.
Haha...
Li Changsheng smiled even more happily.
Ning Ning is different from other children. She has been well-behaved and sensible since she was a child, and she never cries at night.
Although he is only one year old, he seems to know a lot of things and is not difficult to teach at all.
After hugging Li Changsheng for a while.
Ning Ning went down to play by herself.
The world is left to Li Changsheng and Jiang Cuiping.
Jiang Cuiping thought for a while and said, "Husband, although you don't say it, I know you are worried. Recently, there are more and more missing people in the resettlement area and they are becoming more frequent. Are you worried about our safety?"
Li Changsheng nodded.
He didn't expect Jiang Cuiping to be so sensitive.
I guessed pretty well.
Jiang Cuiping touched her bulging belly and said, "If it doesn't work, let's just leave here?"
This is indeed a good approach.
But can we really leave successfully?
Nowadays, troubles occur frequently in the resettlement area. If my guess is true, the decadent Qingyun Sect will not let them leave.
Li Changsheng stretched out his hand, touched Jiang Cuiping's belly, and said calmly:
"I understand."
"Don't worry!"
"I will protect you."
"Well, I believe you." Jiang Cuiping looked at Li Changsheng's side face and lightlyNod lightly.
In fact, she knew that Li Changsheng was hiding his clumsiness. His appearance had not changed for a whole year, and the imitation moon had not left any trace on his body.
This is not the real face of my husband at all.
The husband's real face may be younger.
The sun sets.
Jiang Cuiping leaned on Li Changsheng's chest.
Li Changsheng stroked Jiang Cuiping's slightly bulging belly.
This scene became a beautiful picture.
It was midnight that night.
Li Changsheng, who was lying on the bed, suddenly opened his eyes and glanced at Jiang Cuiping.
Jiang Cuiping slept deeply, breathing steadily, but the quilt was a little off.
He helped him pull up the quilt.
Prevent the mother-in-law from catching cold.
Then quietly walked outside.
Cuiping is right.
People disappear frequently in the resettlement area, so staying here all the time is not an option.
He wanted to see if he could leave.
Li Changsheng took a picture of the third-level invisibility talisman on himself, and then took another picture of the third-level invisibility talisman.
Although his skills can also be concealed, there is double insurance when using magic talismans.
He had only recently learned to draw third-level talismans.
In principle, it cannot be seen through at the peak of foundation building.
Li Changsheng merged with the darkness, like a ghost, walked through the streets of the resettlement area, came to the mountain pass, climbed up an old tree, and looked into the distance.
In fact, he has been to this location many times.
This is also where I went to the black market.
But I didn’t go out for several months.
In fact, there is nothing different here.
It seems that I am too worried.
It is still possible to leave the resettlement area if you want.
Li Changsheng observed for a while and immediately got the answer.
Just when he was about to run away.
Two figures suddenly appeared in the distance.
When Li Changsheng saw this scene, his pupils suddenly shrank.
Although the other one was covered in fog and could not see clearly, one of them was very familiar.
It's him?
What a surprise.
Xie Jian was the outer elder who sent him down the mountain in the first place.
Wherever the eye can see.
At this moment, Xie Jian was sneaking around the mountain pass and kept sprinkling something.
Although Li Changsheng couldn't quite understand it, he still saw something after looking at it for a long time.
What Elder Xie Jian sprinkled should be some kind of formation material.
So...
Xie Jian is setting up a formation?
What formation should be set up at the exit of the resettlement area?
Li Changsheng murmured, feeling an ominous premonition.
He didn't dare to look closer.
Because Elder Xie Jian is in the foundation-building stage, he will be easily discovered if he gets too close.
It seems that what I imagined was correct.
Can't leave.
Trouble!
After Xie Jian left, Li Changsheng left quietly.
He wasn't curious enough to check.
Because curiosity is often a way to commit suicide.
This has been verified by countless time-travelling predecessors.
Li Changsheng would not put himself in danger.
After Li Changsheng returned home, he did not disturb Jiang Cuiping and practiced cross-legged in the living room.
Although his qualifications are poor, basic training is useless.
But it can grow a little.
Just grow a little!
I saw Xie Jian appearing last night.
Proved his idea.
Qingyun Sect has become corrupt.
In other words, some people have become corrupt.
If you want to live.
Then you have to work hard.
Early the next morning, after Li Changsheng had breakfast, he thought about it and went to Old Man Du's house next door.
This is his first visit since being optimized.
Just walked in the door.
Old man Du walked out with a smile and his beloved wife in his arms.
Old Man Du's lovely wife is also very moist.
It's just not comparable to Jiang Cuiping.
After all, Jiang Cuiping is a prosperous husband.
"Old man Li. I haven't seen you in the past year. I thought you were dead? Why are you free to visit now?" Old man Du asked with a smile, his voice was a little uncomfortable.
Haha...
"I have a baby girl, and because of my poor health, I don't go out."
As he spoke, Li Changsheng coughed twice and bent his waist even more, even a little hunched over.
Then he continued:
"My baby drank all the Lingdeer milk. Yes.Can't you buy two cans for me? "
"Why don't you buy it yourself? "
“My legs are a little awkward. And I won’t let you help in vain. I'll give you ten spirit stones for running errands. "
When Old Man Du heard this, his eyes lit up instantly.
Ten spiritual stones!
That's a lot for him.
Since arriving at the resettlement area.
He has lost almost all channels for earning spiritual stones.
"You should have told me earlier! "
"no problem. "
“Wrap it around me. "
“Isn’t it just two cans of Linglu milk? I'll come back as soon as I go. "
Old Man Du's attitude changed 180 degrees.
Not polite at all.
He grabbed the spirit stone handed over by Li Changsheng and stuffed it into his arms.
The wrinkled old face smiled like a withered chrysanthemum.
Ten spiritual stones.
That is, the time spent running errands.
Li Changsheng was indeed taken advantage of.
For the film of a girl who loses money.
To be so generous.
Li Changsheng nodded: "Okay, go back quickly! My baby is still waiting to drink milk! "
"You wait at home and you will definitely be back before sunset. "
Old man Du patted his chest and promised.
Afterwards, he explained a few words to his beloved wife and went out happily.
Seeing Old Man Du leave, the honest look on Li Changsheng's face instantly turned cold.
Although his moral bottom line is very low.
But there will always be a trace of guilt in my heart.
"I'm sorry. "
Li Changsheng muttered something silently in his mind.
He is not the Holy Mother.
I had a bad feeling when I saw Xie Jian setting up the formation last night.
It is impossible for me to gamble.
So he needs someone who can ask for directions.
The money-grubbing old man Du is the best candidate.
This is cruel.
But this is the world of immortality.
A dead Taoist friend is not a poor Taoist.
Li Changsheng stood at the door for a long time, until a cold wind blew by and picked up the dead leaves on the ground, then he turned around and returned to his home.
Return to the yard.
Li Changsheng showed no abnormality.
Still the same as usual.
Tease your daughter.
Talk to your wife.
He even took great interest in thinking of several names for his unborn second child.
But his spiritual consciousness was always paying attention to the entrance direction of the settlement area.
He is waiting for Old Man Du to return.
Until nightfall, Old Man Du did not come back.
Jiang Cuiping put her daughter to sleep, looked at Li Changsheng who was still sitting alone in the yard, and asked softly:
"Husband, what are you looking at? "
Li Changsheng replied: "I'm looking to see if Old Man Du next door is back. "
Jiang Cuiping: "You haven't come back yet? "
Li Changsheng: "No. "
Jiang Cuiping: "It's already midnight, do you think something will happen? "
Li Changsheng came back to his senses, put on a gentle smile, stretched out his hand, and held his wife's somewhat cold hand in his palm.
"What could happen? "
"Old Man Du is a cunning old man and very shrewd. "
“I guess he took the money to drink. "
"Really? "Jiang Cuiping hesitated to ask.
